items.title: Bangladesh Bank sells $200 million to stabilise forex market
items.description: Bangladesh Bank (BB) yesterday sold about $200 million in the interbank market to bring stability to the foreign exchange market and contain the rising cost of the greenback, bankers said.

items.title: Garment workers to get rice at Tk 30 a kilogramme under OMS
items.description: The government is expected to launch a special Open Market Sale (OMS) programme today to sell rice to garment workers at a subsidised price of Tk 30 per kg, as rising living costs put pressure on household budgets.

items.title: Govt overhauls property valuation rules to reflect market prices
items.description: The government has scrapped the minimum mouza rates used to value land and other immovable property and replaced them with actual market prices, aiming to curb tax evasion, reduce undisclosed wealth and raise revenue.

items.title: Fund doubled for marginalised groups, others
items.description: The Bangladesh Bank (BB) has doubled the size of its refinance scheme for marginalised groups, small businesses and students to Tk 1,500, aiming to help them improve their living conditions.
